macros.name: FCDprintenvname
macros.doc: The name of the used environment is held in macro \FCDprintenvname. Redefine it to modify the environment name from its default verbatim.

envs.name: filecontentsdef
envs.doc: The environment creates the file and stores its (verbatim) contents into its second argument \foo (or into the macro \<macro name> with given name).

envs.name: filecontentsdefmacro
envs.doc: A variant environment filecontentsdefmacro stores the contents into a macro, but skips the save-to-a-file part.

envs.name: filecontentsgdef
envs.doc: Use filecontentsgdef for a definition with global scope.
